processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts readings from sensor nodes and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE

processes.name: telemetry normalizer

processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway, device registry, Pub/Sub, telemetry lake, and firmware bucket are in a shared cloud trust zone.
assumptions.basis: The gateway runs on GKE and the other components are identified as managed cloud services: Firestore, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry is confidential because it contains device keys and customer associations.
assumptions.basis: The text says the registry is used to check the key and find which customer the node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake is confidential because it contains site addresses, occupancy patterns, and customer data.
assumptions.basis: The text explicitly states that the lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns and is customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware bucket is public because it is explicitly public read.
assumptions.basis: The text says, "The bucket is public read."

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway is availability-critical because it is the gateway for the deployed sensor fleet.
assumptions.basis: The gateway is the MQTT broker through which the deployed sensor nodes publish readings.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer and telemetry lake contain business-critical data because they process and store the telemetry platform's customer data.
assumptions.basis: The normalizer writes the described customer data into the telemetry lake.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains business-critical data because it stores the platform's customer telemetry.
assumptions.basis: The text describes the lake as containing customer data.

assumptions.assumption: Pub/Sub is availability-critical because it carries accepted sensor readings between the gateway and normalizer.
assumptions.basis: The text says accepted readings are forwarded onto Pub/Sub and picked up by the telemetry normalizer.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware bucket is in the shared cloud trust zone because it is a Cloud Storage bucket.
assumptions.basis: The text identifies the firmware store as a Cloud Storage bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry is in the shared cloud trust zone because it is a Firestore registry.
assumptions.basis: The text identifies the registry as Firestore.

assumptions.assumption: Pub/Sub is in the shared cloud trust zone because it is the named managed messaging service used by the gateway.
assumptions.basis: The text identifies the intermediary as Pub/Sub in the cloud-hosted telemetry path.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake is in the shared cloud trust zone because it is in BigQuery.
assumptions.basis: The text identifies the lake as being in BigQuery.
